item.text: I’ll brute-force the allowable weights and adjacent-column swaps against the checksum rule.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
nums='''978-354181391-9
978-946669746-1
978-398036139-6
978-447656680-4
978-279586664-7
978-595073693-3
978-976647652-6
978-591178125-5
978-728465924-5
978-414825155-9'''.split()
nums=[x.replace('-','') for x in nums]
for w in range(2,10):
 for y in range(3,11):
  valid=True
  for n in nums:
   a=list(map(int,n)); a[y],a[y+1]=a[y+1],a[y]
   if sum(d*(1 if i%2==0 else w) for i,d in enumerate(a))%10:
    valid=False; break
  if valid: print(w,y)
PY"
